## v0.19

- Vibration: the Zodiac's vibration motor is now mapped to your device's haptics, so games and Palm OS alerts that vibrate will rumble. It follows the OS exactly (on while the OS has the motor on) and stops when you open the in-game menu.
- New setting: Vibration On/Off (Settings, default On).
- Not verified on a device: the vibrator switch was found from the ROM's own driver but I couldn't trigger it in the desktop test. If nothing rumbles, tell me which game.
